title: Do Shahzaday, Aun o Mohammad Wich Karbal
body:
Do Shahzaday, Aun o Mohammad wich Karbal de maray gaye
Zainab day aye dovain bachray, Akbar Asghar toun vare gaye
1- Jadon Aun o Muhammad akhaday sarn, sada akhri waar Salam Amma
Zahra daa ladla roo akhay, may ray Masom saharay gaye
2- Zainab ghurbat day Alam wich, qurbani aap tayar kitti
Pani naye si shahzadayan day, hanjowan nul waal sawarey gaye
3- Aye Aun o Mohammed nay logo, enj samjo Jaffar Haider nay
Sab kainday si jadh larna laye, Zainab day raaj dularay gaye
4- Kadi Akbar Asghar tay Qasim, kadi Aun o Mohammed tay Ghazi
Shabbir da vayra ujar gaya, jadon waro wari saray gaye
5- Shabir day sirr day naal raye, Zainab day putran day vi sirr
Jid jid natiq Quran gaya, uss jaa Quran day parey gaye
6- Izhar o vaila nai bhulna, jadon khaimey saarey zaliman nay
Seerat fer bibiyan day burkhey, haye neyzeyan naal utarey gaye
